name: mirage
text:
Short answer: the cheapest setup that keeps the engine working is PropLine Streaming Lite ($39/mo) as the one paid feed, plus the free sockets (Kalshi, Polymarket, SX Bet, Novig).
Why: my 10-24 study found PropLine carries Pinnacle, Bookmaker, SBOBET, Novig, Kalshi and SX, with push on 2 sockets. That covers what SharpAPI and BoltOdds gave us, and mostly what ParlayAPI gave us. SportsGameOdds can go after a two-week overlap. About $39 a month against $800+.
Other options I just looked up (vendor pages, so prices conflict and I haven't tested any):
- TheRundown: has Pinnacle plus 17 books on paid plans. Starter is about $49, but WebSocket needs Ultra at about $399.
- Odds-API.io: about £49-229 a month. WebSocket costs 2x the REST price and allows one connection. I couldn't confirm Pinnacle props.
- SportsGameOdds: streaming only on the top plan. BoltOdds and OpticOdds cost too much for what they add.
Which streaming subscriptions are ending, and which one is PropLine? You said PropLine drops to free today. If so, I'd renew Streaming Lite first; it's the best value I found. Tell me and I'll make the app run on the rest. Notes: research/api_replacements_2026-11-17.md
